  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Executive Assistant to the CEO",
  "description": "CUVA (Celina Unogwu Visioning Academy) is a performance management company with a mission to empower individuals, businesses, and organizations to achieve unprecedented success. Over the years, CUVA has been at the forefront of transforming aspirations into tangible realities, specializing in strategic visioning and planning, visualization, growth mindset mastery, and performance management consulting.

We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Executive Assistant to the CEO

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Job Summary


	The Executive Assistant will serve as a key support function within the Executive Office, working closely with the CEO to ensure effective management of executive priorities and daily activities.
	The role requires a candidate who can anticipate the CEO&#39;s needs, manage competing priorities, maintain confidentiality, coordinate internal and external engagements, and ensure that assigned actions are followed through to completion.
	The Executive Assistant will also serve as an important link between the CEO and internal teams, clients, partners, consultants, and other stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities
Executive &amp; Calendar Management:


	Manage the CEO&#39;s calendar, appointments, meetings, and engagements.
	Schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings.
	Prioritize appointments based on urgency and strategic importance.
	Prepare the CEO&#39;s daily and weekly schedule.
	Send meeting reminders and ensure necessary materials are available.
	Coordinate travel, accommodation, and logistics when required.


Correspondence &amp; Communication:


	Manage and organize incoming and outgoing executive correspondence.
	Draft emails, letters, memos, reports, and other executive documents.
	Follow up on correspondence and outstanding responses.
	Maintain professional communication with clients, partners, consultants, and stakeholders.
	Handle sensitive communication with discretion.


Meeting &amp; Follow-Up Support:


	Prepare meeting agendas and supporting documents.
	Attend meetings where required and take accurate minutes.
	Record decisions, action points, responsibilities, and deadlines.
	Follow up with responsible team members on outstanding action items.
	Maintain an executive action tracker.


Executive Administration:


	Prepare presentations, briefing notes, reports, and executive summaries.
	Maintain organized electronic and physical executive records.
	Manage confidential documents and information.
	Support preparation for management and strategic meetings.
	Assist with research and information gathering for the CEO.


Stakeholder &amp; Relationship Coordination:


	Coordinate communication between the CEO and key stakeholders.
	Support client and partner engagements.
	Schedule stakeholder meetings and follow-ups.
	Maintain an organized stakeholder/contact database.
	Support relationship management activities as assigned.


Task &amp; Project Coordination:


	Track strategic and operational tasks assigned by the CEO.
	Follow up with departments to ensure timely completion of assignments.
	Prepare weekly status updates on pending executive actions.
	Escalate delayed or critical matters to the CEO.
	Support special projects initiated by the CEO.


General Executive Support:


	Conduct research and prepare summaries when required.
	Support event, programme, and workshop coordination.
	Handle official errands and administrative assignments when necessary.
	Perform other duties assigned by the CEO.


Salary
N100,000 / month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: clinikhr@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",
